verdict.rationale: Semgrep Supply Chain documents generating SBOMs that inventory a project's open source components, backed by dependency resolution from manifest parsing. The evidence does not name the SPDX or CycloneDX formats, does not cover container images, and describes no export workflow. missing for 10: explicit SPDX/CycloneDX format support, container image SBOM generation, CLI/API export steps, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a security-engineer, I can generate a software bill of materials (SPDX or CycloneDX) for my project or image

citations.quote: Generate reports and software bills of materials (SBOM) that provide a complete inventory of your open source components
Supply Chain's Dynamic Dependency Resolution provides a complete inventory of your project's dependencies using a combination of manifest parsing and repository integration
